episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: On the first day of school at Bayview High, five students enter detention, but only four come out alive and all of them have secrets to kill for.

episodes.title: One of Us Is Grieving
episodes.summary: The "Bayview Four" go to Simon's wake and become official suspects in his murder. Addy does everything in her power to prevent Jake from discovering her secret.

episodes.title: One of Us Is Not Like the Others
episodes.summary: The "Bayview Four's" secrets start to drop. Bronwyn makes a surprising discovery about her sister. Cooper faces the biggest test of his sports career.

episodes.title: One of Us Is Famous
episodes.summary: The case makes national news and Nate is forced to confront his past. Bronwyn makes a surprising discovery about Cooper, who must deal with a crisis of his own.

episodes.title: One of Us Is Cracking
episodes.summary: The police pressure the suspects, trying to get a confession. A leaked piece of evidence puts Bronwyn in the spotlight. Addy starts to suspect one of her friends.

episodes.title: One of Us Is Dancing!
episodes.summary: At the Homecoming dance, the "Bayview Four" look for evidence against their main suspect in Simon's murder.

episodes.title: One of Us Is Not Giving Up
episodes.summary: The "Bayview Four" race against the clock to uncover the truth about Simon's murder and exonerate one of their own before it's too late.

episodes.title: One of Us Is Dead
episodes.summary: The biggest secret is revealed as the murder club discovers the identity of Simon's killer on Halloween night.

episodes.title: Simon Says Game On
episodes.summary: The aftermath of Jake's death begins to unfold at Bayview. The Murder Club faces a new threat.

episodes.title: Simon Says Tick Tock
episodes.summary: Simon Says blackmails the Murder Club with a surprising demand. Vanessa holds a rally for Jake.

episodes.title: Simon Says Let's Get Personal
episodes.summary: Demands from Simon Says get stranger and more personal. Someone from Jake's past reappears.

episodes.title: Simon Says Gotcha!
episodes.summary: The Murder Club works to find the truth about Giselle. Vanessa digs deeper into Halloween night.

episodes.title: Simon Says Ho Ho Ho!
episodes.summary: As Bayview celebrates the holidays, the Murder Club makes a difficult and shocking decision.

episodes.title: Simon Says You Better Pray
episodes.summary: Vanessa doubles down on her investigation into the Murder Club and finds key evidence.

episodes.title: Simon Says Time Out
episodes.summary: The Murder Club and Vanessa form an unexpected alliance to uncover the truth about Simon Says.

episodes.title: Simon Says Game Over
episodes.summary: The Murder Club hatches a risky plan to stop Simon Says, but what they don't know could hurt them.
